text:
alex_infra: Heads-up — we've got a spike of Xid 13/31/48 on the us-east-1 g4dn pool this morning, ~45 errors in 2 hours. Noticed after the night batch of long-sequence Llama-2-13B jobs.
jamie_gpu: saw the same alerts. GPU telemetry shows ECC single-bit rising on host gpu-ue1-17 (asset tag: rdw-gpu-117). dmesg excerpt: 
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, PID=9876, GPU=0
[ 12345.678902] NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus.
```

natalie_eng: Job metadata: nightly-llama-13b-batch, batch_size=32, seq_len=2048, kv-cache warm on repeated prefixes. Any correlation to sequence length?
jamie_gpu: yes — >1500 tokens sessions show higher incidence. Could be KV pressure + continuous attention kernels triggering a corner-case in driver.
sre-oncall: ops-bot aggregated counts by host and code: Xid13=29, Xid31=9, Xid48=7. Most Xid48 map to eu-west-1 but same model family on different infra.
ops-bot: Incident summary created: INC-20270314-324, linked to runbook /playbooks/gpu-xid-triage.md : https://internal/inc/INC-20270314-324
luca_reliability: quick triage idea — run a controlled repro on gpu-ue1-17 with smaller sequence but repeated KV ops to see if Xid triggers. Also check BIOS/firmware versions; previous flaky cards were fixed by driver 535.XX rollout.
alex_infra: I’m scheduling a cordon/drain for gpu-ue1-17 in 30m if errors persist. Proposed command: `kubectl drain gpu-ue1-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` then power-cycle.
natalie_eng: can we throttle batch_size to 8 for that nightly job as a quick mitigation? reduces throughput but might avoid Xid storm.
jamie_gpu: logs from nvidia-smi -q during a failure attached in thread (snippet): 
```
Product Name: Tesla T4
FB Memory Usage: 32000 MiB total
ECC Errors (L1 cache): 14
```

sre-oncall: cost note — US pool outages push workloads to dedicated nodes in us-west and eu which increases cross-region egress and cost spike ~= +$2.5k last 3h. We should include cost impact in postmortem.
luca_reliability: if ECC counts keep climbing, ops should replace the card. Vendor RMA for the rack is available; but let's confirm persistent ECC and a repro.
alex_infra: Action items: 1) natalie throttle batch for nightly run (done?) 2) jamie run controlled repro and gather dmesg/nvlogs 3) sre-oncall calculate cost delta and open postmortem doc 4) if reproduction confirmed, schedule maintenance and RMA for gpu-ue1-17.
natalie_eng: reduced batch_size on nightly to 8 and restarted job (status: running). Will report back in 45m.
jamie_gpu: starting repro now — script will run two 2k token generations in a loop, attaching nvidia-smi sampling (1s) and driver logs.
sre-oncall: added cost tracking tag to INC-20270314-324, pinging finance for temporary budget approval.
ops-bot: 1815014000 — automated log collection completed for gpu-ue1-17, uploaded to s3://rdw-telemetry/gpu-xid/1815014000.tar.gz
alex_infra: thanks team. If we see >3 Xids after drain we'll escalate to vendor. For tracking, keeping this thread as the canonical triage. :white_check_mark:
jamie_gpu: preliminary repro shows 2 Xid13 in 10m under heavy KV churn. Saving logs and will attach to ticket.
luca_reliability: noting hypothesis: combination of long sequence KV cache thrash + older driver causing stale mapping -> Xid13/31. Next steps: try driver 535.54 on a staging host and rerun.
